Faith as a subscription funnel. I downloaded this app after seeing a lot of ads. The app itself feels mediocre and emotionally manipulative in its onboarding process. As Christians, we all want to feel closer to God, but praying is free, not $40.

What bothered me most is how aggressively monetized the experience feels, especially for a faith-centered app. The developers frequently highlight their monthly revenue on X, which made the whole experience feel more focused on maximizing subscriptions than serving a genuine spiritual purpose. I also found it disappointing that I couldn’t find any indication that a portion of proceeds supports charitable or Christian organizations.
